edit.description: mentionOf a nested skill displays its invocation spelling rendered from placement

summary: A mention of a nested skill renders the invocation spelling its placement gives (/apps/web:deploy), never the identity
acceptance: a mention of skill:apps:web:deploy displays /apps/web:deploy while its address stays the identity; pnpm --dir sdk test green
notes: SDK-only behavior. The rendering rule is builtins.md skill bullet: invocation from the placement, never the identity.
